digest.component_or_area: external integration test suite and CI workflows
propositions: The external integration suite exercises only one provider (Anthropic) end-to-end under live test, leaving Bedrock and OpenAI regressions undetected by CI automation.
Provider selection must become an explicit matrix dimension in CI workflows rather than an ambient default, with each arm selecting its provider via REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE overlay.
The Bedrock arm requires OIDC role assumption and explicit region resolution (AWS_DEFAULT_REGION and REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION) on GitHub-hosted runners, not the EC2 instance-role path used by S7.
Arms with missing credentials must skip loudly and be visibly distinguishable from successful runs, never reading as green or silently passing.
The ambient default model (cfg.model) must resolve to the declared provider on each matrix arm, not fall back to bare literal Anthropic, requiring both class-based and ambient-default assertions.
